verdict.reasoning: The printed page 827 (printed folio 805) shows Figure E.15 as a flowchart: Entrance -> 'Set identifier-2 equal to current FROM value' -> 'Execute specified set of statements' -> Condition-1 (True -> Exit; False -> 'Augment identifier-2 with current BY value'), and a line leaves the left side of the Augment box, runs up the left margin and enters with an arrowhead just above 'Execute specified set of statements'. The markdown (page-827.md lines 3-19) holds only the node labels in sequence, with no edges, so the loop that makes this a TEST AFTER iteration is absent; it also merges 'True', 'Condition-1' and 'Exit' into 'True\ Condition-1 Exit'. The claim quotes both sources accurately. The loss is of the figure's control flow, not furniture or wrapping, so it is a genuine content discrepancy; the annex is informative, so it carries no normative weight.
verdict.corrected_description: Figure E.15 is transcribed as its node labels only: every edge is lost, including the meaningful loop-back from 'Augment identifier-2 with current BY value' to the entry of 'Execute specified set of statements', and the True/Exit branch off Condition-1 is collapsed into the text 'True Condition-1 Exit'. Informative annex E; no normative impact.
